# CXNM - Standard - MAC - U - Microsoft Edge Updates

How and when Edge on the Mac updates itself.

| | |
|---|---|
| Platform | macOS |
| Scope | User (U) — assign to user groups |
| Type | Settings Catalog |
| Assignment | All Users |
| Source | OpenIntuneBaseline macOS v1.0 — Microsoft Edge - U - Updates |
| File | [`Baseline_MAC_U_Microsoft_Edge_Updates.json`](Baseline_MAC_U_Microsoft_Edge_Updates.json) |

> Supplemented to the same behaviour as the Windows counterpart. relaunchnotification was already set to Required (on macOS 1 = Required and 0 = Recommended, the reverse of what you would expect), but without a period that notification never ends. Now relaunchnotificationperiod is set to 259200000 milliseconds, 3 days and thus equal to Windows, and relaunchfastifoutdated to 7 days. The macOS catalog has no relaunch window (com.apple.managedclient.preferences_relaunchwindow does not exist there), so that one difference with Windows remains.
